detail.longDescription:
Assuming the numbers #ChatGPT provides are correct (they most likely aren't) it would take 288GJ to accelerate two space probes into opposite direction simultaneously to the speed of Voyager 1 (61000km/h) using magnetic propulsion.

(Two probes to offset the kinetic energy and keep the launchpad stationary)

And further it would take about 8km^2 of solar panels to harvest that kind of energy in under one day.

Would be an interesting project to calculare for real though.
